title: Bonus
section: 45. Bonus Lecture - Succeed in the Age of AI
summary: A short promotional trailer for a separate bonus course on productivity and using AI tools well. It contains no coding content.

concepts.heading: What the bonus course promises
points: Covers frameworks for keeping focus when many tasks feel urgent.
Covers using AI tools as a thinking partner, strategist and coach for coding, studying and work.
Claims a large coding-productivity gain from adopting current AI-assisted development practices.
Covers building habits that accumulate into long-term results.
